title: Beloved
lyrics: Verse 1:
[C]Love of My life, look deep in My eyes;
There you will find what you [F]need.
[C]Give Me your life, the lust and the lies,
The past you're afraid I might [F]see.
You've been [A#]running away from [G]Me.
Chorus 1:
You're my be[Am]love[F]d, lover I'm [C]yours.[G]
Death shall not [Am]part us;[F] it's you I died [G]for.
For better or [Am]wors[F]e, forever we'll [C]be.[G]
Our love it u[Am]nites us,[F] and it binds you to [G]Me;
It's a myste[Am]ry.
Verse 2:
Love of My life, look deep in My eyes;
There you will find what you need.
I'm the Giver of Life, I'll clothe you in white;
My immaculate bride you will be.
Oh, come running home to Me.
Bridge 1:
Well you've [F]been a mistress, My [C]wife.
You're chasing [Am]lovers, that [G]won't satis[Am]fy.
Won't you [F/G]let Me make you My [Am]bride?
You will [F]drink of my lips and you'll [G]taste new life.
